subject: Vessel Movement Plan for the next 48 Hrs. 13-May-2026
narrative:
All,

Please see the below Vessel Movement plan for next 48hrs.:


Allianz Juno...



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at North Port. Vessel will remain STBY at North Port.
  *   Tomorrow 13th May, Vessel will sail 1st Trip to Rig Oriental Dragon-1 with KOC Crew Change Pax, ETD from Shuaiba Port at 06.00hrs. Vessel will return to Shuaiba Port Via North Port.
  *   Tomorrow 13th May, Vessel will sail 2nd Run to Rig Oriental Phoenix with food containers & Crew Change Pax, ETD 11.00hrs., Vessel will return to Shuaiba Port via North Port & STBY at Shuaiba Port.



 Crest Argus 1...



  *   Vessel currently STBY at Shuaiba Port, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Dragon-1.
  *   Tomorrow 14th May, Vessel will sail to Oriental Dragon-1, ETD 16.00 Hrs.


Crest Argus 3...



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at Rig Oriental Phoenix, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Phoenix.
  *   Tomorrow 13th May, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Phoenix.



Crest Argus 5....



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at Oriental Dragon-1, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Dragon-1.
  *   Tomorrow 13th May, Vessel will sail to Shuaiba Port, ETD 19.00hrs.



Crew change details will be sent by Rig Logistics/ Aisha/ Ahmed Modather.



Gary,

Kindly approve the above Vessel Movement Plan.
